title: A Complete Geometric Message-Passing Architecture for Point Clouds
abstract: arXiv:2611.26384v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Three-dimensional point clouds are a fundamental data modality, and a large family of machine learning architectures has been developed to respect their natural symmetries to rigid motions and permutations. A principled way to compare these architectures, which vary widely in complexity and cost, is through their expressive power. That is, an architecture is complete if it can distinguish any two inputs not related by the symmetries it respects. Simple distance-based message-passing networks are known to be incomplete, and while there exist complete alternatives, they typically rely on computationally intensive mechanisms like high-order representations of the rotation group or higher-order Weisfeiler-Leman-type tests.   In this work, we devise a novel, simple, equivariant message-passing architecture for point clouds, and prove that it is complete. translated_title: 一种用于点云的完全几何消息传递架构
translated_abstract: 三维点云是一种基础的数据模态，为了尊重其关于刚体运动和置换的自然对称性，研究者们已经开发了大量的机器学习架构。比较这些在复杂度与计算成本上差异巨大的架构的一种原则性方法，是考察它们的表达能力。具体而言，如果一个架构能够区分任何两个不由其所遵循的对称性相互关联的输入，那么该架构就是完全的。众所周知，简单的基于距离的消息传递网络是不完全的，而现有的完全架构通常依赖于计算代价高昂的机制，例如旋转群的高阶表示或高阶Weisfeiler-Leman型测试。在本工作中，我们设计了一种新颖、简单、等变的点云消息传递架构，并证明了它是完全的。我们还通过实验补充了理论结果，实验表明我们的架构能够分离……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种新颖而简单的等变消息传递架构用于点云，并从理论上证明了其完全性，无需依赖计算密集的高阶旋转群表示或高阶Weisfeiler-Leman测试即可区分任意非对称等价的输入。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel, simple, equivariant message-passing architecture for point clouds and proves its completeness, distinguishing any two inputs not related by symmetry without relying on computationally intensive mechanisms such as high-order rotation group representations or higher-order Weisfeiler-Leman tests.
